tasks.title: Build the FocusTrap primitive
tasks.description: Create components/a11y/focus-trap.tsx: save the invoking element, move focus to the first focusable node inside, cycle Tab/Shift+Tab, close on Escape, restore focus on unmount, and fall back to main when the trigger is gone.

tasks.title: Build VisuallyHidden and SkipLink
tasks.description: Create components/a11y/visually-hidden.tsx and skip-link.tsx: clip-based hidden text, and a skip link rendered as the first focusable element targeting #main.

tasks.title: Build the LiveRegion provider and hook
tasks.description: Create components/a11y/live-region.tsx exposing announce(message, politeness) with a polite and an assertive region; mount once in the root layout.

tasks.title: Add focus helpers
tasks.description: Create lib/a11y/focus.ts with rememberFocus, restoreFocus, and focusFirstInvalid(container) so dialogs and forms share one implementation.

tasks.title: Add landmarks and the skip link to the root layout
tasks.description: Modify app/layout.tsx to render the skip link once and wrap content in header, main#main, and footer landmarks; keep exactly one h1 per page by moving titles into pages.

tasks.title: Make the home page keyboard operable
tasks.description: Modify app/page.tsx and components/event-card.tsx: keyboard-operable cards with a visible focus ring and accessible names; the carousel becomes manual under prefers-reduced-motion and announces its position.

tasks.title: Harden the event page semantics and hero shell
tasks.description: Modify app/events/[slug]/page.tsx: single h1, heading order, contrast and focus fixes, and a hero shell that reserves its box with next/image dimensions and priority.

tasks.title: Label the registration form and connect its errors
tasks.description: Modify app/events/[slug]/register/page.tsx: programmatic labels, aria-describedby for hints and errors, aria-invalid on failure, and focus to the first invalid field.

tasks.title: Announce ticket readiness
tasks.description: Wire the ticket view to announce readiness once through the live region, without moving focus or re-announcing on re-render.

tasks.title: Announce feedback submission outcomes
tasks.description: Announce feedback success and failure through the live region and keep focus in place; adopt the shared label and error pattern.

tasks.title: Make dropdown menus keyboard operable
tasks.description: Modify components/ui/select.tsx: arrow-key movement, Home/End, Escape, and an announced active option, using the shared dialog and focus primitives.

tasks.title: Honour reduced motion and standardise the focus ring
tasks.description: Modify app/globals.css: a prefers-reduced-motion block that disables autoplay, transitions, and parallax, and a :focus-visible ring token of 2px at 3:1 contrast.

tasks.title: Correct failing contrast tokens
tasks.description: Adjust only the colour tokens that fail 4.5:1 text or 3:1 UI contrast and record the before/after ratios; ensure no state relies on colour alone.

tasks.title: Serve the hero image through next/image
tasks.description: Use next/image with explicit dimensions and priority so the hero reserves its box and does not shift layout; verify CLS on a throttled profile.

tasks.title: Stabilise font loading
tasks.description: Use display: swap with metric-compatible fallbacks so the web font swap does not shift layout.

tasks.title: Trim the event page's first-load JavaScript
tasks.description: Move interactive islands behind client boundaries and dynamic imports so first-load JS stays at or below 180KB gzip while first paint remains server-rendered.

tasks.title: Add the axe-core reference-page suite
tasks.description: Create test/a11y/axe.test.tsx rendering home, event detail, registration, ticket, and feedback, asserting zero WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations.

tasks.title: Add the Lighthouse budget
tasks.description: Create .lighthouserc.json for the event page on the pinned mobile profile: performance and accessibility at least 95, LCP at most 2500ms, CLS at most 0.1, TBT at most 200ms.

tasks.title: Wire the scripts and development dependencies
tasks.description: Add axe-core, vitest-axe, and @lhci/cli as dev dependencies plus a11y and lighthouse scripts so both gates run non-interactively.
